what_it_claims: A ten-case query surface consisting of the unchanged Atlas-3 kernel plus seven source-bound follow-on evidence packages.
Machine-queryable reaction gaps, source granularity, M-CSA curved-arrow endpoints, residue-number mappings, structure applicability, uncertainty, and two bounded relationship projections.
what_it_does_not_claim: Ten equally detailed mechanisms, representative benchmark coverage, independent biological validation, prospective discovery, atom-mapped bond edits, complete turnover trajectories, or design readiness.
